CancerVerse: A Fully Open Longitudinal and Multimodal Dataset for Multicancer Screening
	

  
We present CancerVerse, a fully open longitudinal and multimodal CT dataset for multicancer screening. It contains 24,422 CT scans from 14,599 patients, followed over time for up to 14.4 years. CT scans were collected at hospitals in Switzerland and Turkey from 2010 to 2025. Human experts drew voxel-wise tumor annotations for 13 cancer types in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest.
